issues.expectedValue: An approved text style (closest: DSD Test / Button label)

issues.suggestedAction: Apply the closest approved text style, or add this combination to the design system if it’s needed.

compliance.formula: Each checked property scores 1 if it passes, 0.5 with a warning, 0 with an error. Compliance is the average across every checked property. Hidden and unreadable layers are not counted.
